message: No detected input validation: No schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards are applied to incoming data or configuration parameters anywhere in the code.

No detected untrusted source handling: Data is loaded from local filesystem paths (e.g., opt.img_path, opt.json_path, conf.data_path) with no checksum verification, signed URLs, or authentication of any remote source.
No detected label flipping detection: No code checks label distributions, validates label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool before training.
No detected data poisoning defenses: There is no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checking, or filtering of suspicious inputs applied to the training data anywhere in the pipeline code shown.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads pretrained weights via torch.load and references a pre_trained_model_path without any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision validation.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, expected label sets, or anomalous sample detection before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse-style trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training code.
No detected differential privacy: The optimizer is a standard SGD with no differential privacy wrappers such as Opacus or TensorFlow Privacy applied.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing libraries (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) or adversarial attack routines are present anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no evidence of held-out test set isolation enforcement, signed/hashed evaluation data, or multiple independent metrics to guard against metric manipulation; validation data is loaded from a fixed path with no integrity checks.
No detected input sanitization: No input validation or sanitization is performed on incoming images or requests before passing them to the face recognition or YOLO models in the inference path.

No detected output bounds checks: While a fixed threshold (conf.threshold = 1.5) is configured, there are no runtime checks for NaN values, probability sanity bounds, or output validation on model predictions in the visible inference code.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a computer vision pipeline (face recognition and object detection), not an LLM, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable.
